knowledge:
- key_parameters: nonparametric=Boolean indicating whether to use the Non-Parametric background correction method ;; RMA=Boolean indicating whether to use the RMA background correction method (does not require negative controls) ;; MLE=Boolean indicating whether to use the Maximum Likelihood Estimation background correction method ;; GMLE=Boolean indicating whether to use the Generalized Maximum Likelihood Estimation background correction method ;; MCMC=Boolean indicating whether to use the Markov Chain Monte Carlo (Bayesian) background correction method ;; paramEstFile=Prefix string for parameter estimation output files in mbcb.main ;; bgCorrectedFile=Prefix string for background corrected output files in mbcb.main ;; normMethod=Normalization method to apply after background correction ("none", "quant", or "median")
- alternatives: RMA is noted as an alternative background correction method commonly used on Affymetrix data that does not require negative control beads, whereas the other four methods require negative control files.
- when_to_use: Use when preprocessing Illumina BeadArray expression data, particularly when negative control probe data is available to improve background correction accuracy.
- pitfalls: Quantile normalization (normMethod="quant") requires the external packages 'affy' and 'affyio' to be installed. MCMC and GMLE methods are computationally intensive and are set to FALSE by default in standard workflows.

workflows.name: illumina_beadarray_background_correction
workflows.intent: Parse, background-correct, and normalize Illumina BeadArray expression data using model-based techniques.
workflows.stages: 1. Parse the input signal and negative control files ;; 2. Define background correction method logical flags ;; 3. Perform background correction using mbcb.correct or mbcb.main ;; 4. Apply normalization (quantile or median) and read the corrected output files
